top5.title: Delays threaten Microsoft’s AI data-center partners
top5.description: Microsoft cut its annual capital-spending forecast by $5 billion, with its CFO citing delays at third-party cloud providers among other factors. Satellite analysis suggests that two data-center projects could be affected.
top5.why: Microsoft’s $5 billion capital-spending cut and delays at partner data centers signal that AI infrastructure deployment may be hitting execution and supply constraints.

top5.title: ChatGPT reportedly accounts for around 20% of Google’s search volume
top5.description: OpenAI chief product officer Adam Fry says ChatGPT has reached around 20% of Google’s search volume. If accurate, this would make the chatbot Google Search’s most serious challenger in decades.
top5.why: If accurate, ChatGPT reaching roughly 20% of Google’s search volume would mark the most serious competitive threat to Google Search in decades and accelerate the shift toward AI-mediated discovery.

top5.title: The biggest AI spenders stagnate in the third quarter
top5.description: AI adoption continues to grow among other companies, but spending by the top 1% of customers stagnated in the third quarter. Anthropic’s dollar growth also stalled.
top5.why: Stagnant spending among the largest AI customers and slowing Anthropic growth suggest that enterprise AI demand may be broadening without yet supporting the sector’s biggest spending expectations.

top5.title: OpenAI plans to acquire code-hosting startup Pierre
top5.description: OpenAI has agreed to acquire Pierre Computer, the startup that already hosts Codex’s code repositories. The deal brings OpenAI closer to GitHub’s territory.
top5.why: OpenAI’s planned acquisition of Pierre would strengthen its control of code repositories and move Codex closer to competing directly with GitHub.

top5.title: Moonshot releases the open weights of its Kimi K3.1 Pro model
top5.description: Moonshot released Kimi K3.1 Pro with open, downloadable weights, text and image understanding, and a one-million-token memory. The model is distributed under a custom license and can be tried on HuggingChat.
top5.why: Moonshot’s release of downloadable weights for a multimodal model with a one-million-token context window intensifies competition around open, deployable frontier AI.
